notes:
Describes an extreme level of enthusiasm or passion, often implying being swept up in excitement. Can be positive (devoted fans) or negative (blind fanaticism). Very common in media descriptions of fan culture, sports, and popular movements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱狂的|ねっきょうてき}な⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: fanatical fan
- {熱狂的|ねっきょうてき}な⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧: fervent support
- {熱狂的|ねっきょうてき}な⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧: rapturous welcome
- {熱狂的|ねっきょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧: to cheer fervently
- {熱狂的|ねっきょうてき}な⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧: frenzied popularity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{情熱的|じょうねつてき}→情熱的：16048_jounetsuteki⟧: passionate — emphasizes deep personal passion, often in a romantic or artistic sense
- {狂信的|きょうしんてき}: fanatical, zealous — strongly negative; implies blind, irrational belief
- ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧: absorbed, crazy about — more casual; describes being engrossed in something

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{熱狂|ねっきょう}→熱狂：13479_nekkyou⟧ (frenzy, craze) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ means heat/fever and {狂|きょう} means madness.

definitions.explanation: showing intense, passionate enthusiasm or excitement that goes beyond ordinary levels; fervently devoted
